snippet.title: The Little Mermaid PC 1999 Midas Interactive
snippet.description:
This is an old point and click game from 1999 that some may remember from their childood. 

"The conflict of good and evil is at play in this ancient tale. Now children can take part in the underwater magic. Brilliant full screen animation and various interactive games will captivate you childrens imagination".

The files have been put on the Internet Archive
